scope: Kaby i5-8250U Qwen3/Qwen2.5 Q8_0 strict CPU warm-session performance lane after SLM-CPU-182
claim_boundary: SLM-CPU-183 defines the evidence gate required before any future no-bias dense-linear fast path.
This slice does not implement, select, or enable a no-bias dense-linear fast path.
This slice does not prove every Qwen3/Qwen2.5 dense-linear role is biasless.
This slice does not change runtime behavior or default runtime selection.
This slice does not claim allocation reduction, timing improvement, speedup, sustained throughput, Q4/Q5 runtime support, server, GPU/NPU/OpenVINO/UHD 620, Qwen3.5, or BitNet QK256 behavior.

consumed_classification.existing_receipt_evidence: Qwen3/Qwen2.5 strict receipts show zero sidecar bias materialization calls, but they are not a per-role dense-linear bias-presence manifest.

model_init_trace_requirements: Each selected dense-linear role records the constructor path that loaded the weight.
Each selected dense-linear role records whether a bias tensor was found during model initialization.
Each selected dense-linear role records the exact canonical role id and source GGUF tensor names for weight and optional bias.
The trace records the model SHA, quant format, tokenizer authority, runtime commit, and selected CPU backend used for the associated strict receipt.
tensor_manifest_requirements: The manifest includes every dense-linear source tensor name for the exact Qwen3/Qwen2.5 Q8_0 artifact.
The manifest records positive presence or absence evidence for the bias tensor paired with every role weight.
The manifest records output-head mode explicitly before any output-head no-bias decision.
The manifest hash or artifact path is recorded in the paired strict receipt.

role_record_schema.role_id: canonical dense-linear role, for example layers.0.attention.q_proj or layers.0.feed_forward.down_proj
role_record_schema.layer_index: integer layer index, or null for output-head/global roles
role_record_schema.role_family: attention_q_proj | attention_k_proj | attention_v_proj | attention_o_proj | feed_forward_gate_proj | feed_forward_up_proj | feed_forward_down_proj | output_head_lm_head | output_head_tied_embedding
role_record_schema.weight_name: canonical or GGUF source weight tensor name
role_record_schema.weight_shape: runtime matrix shape used by the selected dense path
role_record_schema.weight_dtype: weight tensor dtype before any dense path conversion
role_record_schema.bias_tensor_name: bias tensor name or null when absent
role_record_schema.bias_shape: bias tensor shape or null when absent
role_record_schema.bias_dtype: bias dtype or null when absent
role_record_schema.eligible_for_no_bias_fast_path: true only when bias_present=false and the role is otherwise allowlisted
role_record_schema.ineligible_reason: null when eligible, otherwise the exact fail-closed reason

role_requirements.required_coverage: one role record per layer and projection for the exact model artifact
role_requirements.bias_absence_requirement: bias_present must be false for the exact role/layer before that role can use any future no-bias fast path

role_requirements.required_coverage: one role record per layer and projection for the exact model artifact
role_requirements.bias_absence_requirement: bias_present must be false for the exact role/layer before that role can use any future no-bias fast path
dedicated or transposed lm_head paths require explicit bias evidence; tied embeddings must record output_head_mode=tied_embeddings and prove no output-head bias add is involved

fail_closed_conditions: The bias manifest or model-init trace is missing.
The manifest model_sha256 does not match the paired strict Qwen3/Qwen2.5 receipt.
The manifest model family or quant format does not match the selected runtime artifact.
tokenizer_strict is not true or tokenizer_source is not GGUF metadata or another accepted strict source recorded in the paired receipt.
A selected dense-linear role is missing from role_records.
bias_present is true for the selected role.
bias_present is unknown, null, or omitted for the selected role.
output_head_mode is unknown for an output-head role.
The selected role is not in the allowlist.
Before/after generated IDs, decoded text, prompt IDs, model SHA, tokenizer authority, selected CPU backend/kernel, dense path identity, or fallback status drift.
No-bias selector identity, fallback status, or bias materialization counters are missing from the paired receipts.

enable_conditions: Exact per-role bias manifest exists for Qwen3 Q8_0 and Qwen2.5 Q8_0 model artifacts under test.
Every selected role has bias_present=false in the manifest or model-init trace.
The selected role is in the dense-linear role allowlist.
Output-head roles record output_head_mode and bias policy explicitly.

Paired strict before/after receipts preserve model SHA, strict tokenizer authority, prompt IDs, generated IDs, decoded text, selected backend/kernel, dense path identity, stop policy, and fallback_used=false.
Paired receipts record no-bias selector identity plus bias_materialization_calls, bias_materialization_ns, and bias_values_materialized.
Any allocation, timing, or speed claim is backed by phase-specific counters from the affected warm-session profile.
blocked_until: A real model-init trace or tensor manifest provides per-role/layer bias presence.
Receipts carry manifest identity and no-bias selector identity.
Cross-model Qwen3/Qwen2.5 strict before/after behavior receipts are present.

classification.reason: The code can represent missing-bias Linear roles and existing strict receipts show zero sidecar bias materialization calls, but those receipts are not a per-role/layer manifest. Any future no-bias dense-linear selector must fail closed unless exact Qwen3/Qwen2.5 Q8_0 bias presence is proven for the selected role and paired receipts preserve behavior.
classification.recommended_next_action: Capture a model-init bias-presence manifest or tensor manifest for exact Qwen3/Qwen2.5 Q8_0 attention, feed-forward, and output-head roles.

must_not_claim: SLM-CPU-183 implements or selects a no-bias dense-linear fast path.
SLM-CPU-183 proves all Qwen3/Qwen2.5 dense-linear roles are biasless.
Generated IDs, decoded text, prompt IDs, model SHA, tokenizer source, backend/kernel identity, or fallback status change.
Allocation reduction, timing improvement, speedup, sustained throughput, broad decode latency, prefill latency, model-load latency, or warm-session end-to-end speedup is proven.
Q4_K_M or Q4_K_S runtime support exists.
Server, GPU, NPU, OpenVINO, or UHD 620 execution is involved.
Qwen3.5 or hybrid architecture support is in scope.
